mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM px_visits) visitsNumber, (SELECT count(*) FROM px_leave_message) messageNumber, (SELECT count(*) FROM px_article) articleNumber, (SELECT count(*) FROM px_photo) photoNumber

SELECT count(*) articleNumber, d.dict_value typeCode, d.dict_label typeName FROM px_article a LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON a.type = d.dict_value AND d.dict_type = 'px_article_type' GROUP BY a.type, d.dict_value, d.dict_label
SELECT count(*) value, d.dict_label name FROM px_photo a LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON a.type = d.dict_value AND d.dict_type = 'px_album_name' GROUP BY a.type, d.dict_label

SELECT temp.date, COALESCE(p.unmber, 0) number FROM ( SELECT adddate(date_add(#{date}, interval - day(#{date}) + 1 day), numlist.id) AS 'date' FROM ( SELECT n1.i + n10.i * 10 + n100.i * 100 AS id FROM num n1 CROSS JOIN num AS n10 CROSS JOIN num AS n100 ) AS numlist WHERE adddate(date_add(#{date}, interval - day(#{date}) + 1 day), numlist.id) <= date_add( date_add(#{date}, interval - day(#{date}) + 1 day), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ) temp LEFT JOIN (SELECT LEFT (create_time, 10) AS udate, count(1) unmber FROM px_visits GROUP BY udate) p ON temp.date = p.udate order by date

SELECT left (temp.date, 7) date, COALESCE (q.unmber, 0) number FROM ( SELECT adddate(CONCAT(YEAR (#{date}), '-', '01', '-', '01'), interval numlist.id month) AS 'date' FROM ( SELECT * from (SELECT n1.i + n10.i * 10 AS id FROM num n1 CROSS JOIN num AS n10) a where a.id <= 11 ) AS numlist WHERE adddate(CONCAT(YEAR (#{date}), '-', '01', '-', '01'), interval numlist.id month) <= CONCAT(YEAR (#{date}), '-', '12', '-', '01') ) temp LEFT JOIN (SELECT LEFT (create_time, 7) AS udate, count(1) unmber FROM px_visits GROUP BY udate) q ON left (temp.date, 7) = q.udate ORDER BY left (temp.date, 7)

SELECT temp.date, COALESCE(p.unmber, 0) number FROM ( SELECT adddate(date_add(#{date}, interval - day(#{date}) + 1 day), numlist.id) AS 'date' FROM ( SELECT n1.i + n10.i * 10 + n100.i * 100 AS id FROM num n1 CROSS JOIN num AS n10 CROSS JOIN num AS n100 ) AS numlist WHERE adddate(date_add(#{date}, interval - day(#{date}) + 1 day), numlist.id) <= date_add( date_add(#{date}, interval - day(#{date}) + 1 day), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ) temp LEFT JOIN (SELECT LEFT (m.create_time, 10) AS udate, count(1) unmber FROM px_leave_message m left join px_article pa on m.article_id = pa.id GROUP BY udate) p ON temp.date = p.udate order by date

select province name, count(1) value from px_visits where country = '中国' and unix_timestamp(create_time) between unix_timestamp(#{startDate}) and unix_timestamp(#{endDate}) group by province
